title: Umurinzi ku nkengera y'uruzi
intro: Mu gihugu aho itegeko ry’umunyagitugu ryazanye umubabaro mu ngo nyinshi, umutima wararonse ubutumwa bwari burengeye ubwoba bwose. Bafise umutima wuzuye ukwizigira, baratanguye igikorwa c’ukwizera cohinduye inzira y’ihanga. Uko amazi yariko atwara umuzigo w’agaciro, icizigiro caravanze n’imipfunda.
clues: Naronse ivyiyumviro vy’Imana vyampaye umutima rugabo.
Nategetswe kutagira ubwoba canke ngo ngire intuntu.
Nashize umwana wanje mu gasandugu, ndamushira hejuru y’amazi.
Umwana wanje yaronswe n’abo mu rugo rw’umutware, ariko uwundi mwana wanje arakurikira.
Nasubiye guhura n’umwana wanje kugira ngo ndamuyonse, nk’uko Allah yabisezeranye.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Kuba yahumekewe guterera umwana mu ruzi .
trial.answer: Kuba yahumekewe guterera umwana mu ruzi .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Uwo mwana yasubijwe ku muforoma ata nkomanzi .
Uwo mwana bamujana mu gihugu ca kure + .
Uwo mwana aca aba umutware ubwo nyene .
Uwo mwana yarezwe n’umudandaza w’umutunzi wa mbere .
outcome.answer: Uwo mwana yasubijwe ku muforoma ata nkomanzi .

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
